#giftedbydrunkelephant Drunk Elephant Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser Review I've been testing out the Drunk Elephant Beste No. 9 Jelly Cleanser, and here's my honest take on it. Texture & Application As the name suggests, this is a jelly cleanser with a lightweight, gel-like consistency. It spreads easily on damp skin and doesn't foam much, which makes it feel quite gentle. A little goes a long way, so you don't need to use too much product. Cleansing Power It does a great job of removing sunscreen, light makeup, and daily grime without stripping the skin. However, for heavier makeup, I'd recommend using a cleansing balm or micellar water first. This works better as a second cleanse in a double-cleansing routine rather than a standalone makeup remover. Ingredients & Skin Benefits One of the standout features is its clean, fragrance-free formula—no essential oils, SLS, or drying alcohols. Instead, it's infused with: Mild surfactants (Cocamidopropyl Betaine & Glycerin) that cleanse without irritation Aloe & Cantaloupe Extract to soothe and hydrate Marula Oil for added nourishment It's a pH-balanced formula (5.5), so it won't disrupt your skin barrier. Who It's Best For ✅ Oily to combination skin – Works well without leaving skin dry or greasy. ✅ Sensitive skin – No harsh irritants, making it a good choice for delicate skin types. ✅ Minimalist routines – If you like simple, effective cleansing without fancy actives, this is for you.
